description: A radio operator observes a field repair only through a fixed camera feed.

session.personaDescription: An operator seated at a communications desk.

interactions.content: I watch the ridge camera and tell Pavel that the upper cable is still loose.
Over the radio Pavel answers, "Copy, tightening it now," and reaches for the upper cable on the relay mast.

Edda remains inside the operations room, visible only at her desk. On the separate ridge camera feed, Pavel braces beside the relay mast and tightens the upper cable; neither character shares a physical location.
